milestones.note: Start of the first modern bull run
ALL-TIME HIGH. Low rates, COVID liquidity, retail flood
Trough. −49.5%. NRB tightening, FD rates above 11%

stages.label: 1 · Displacement
stages.note: NRB cuts rates. Banking system flush with liquidity. Online trading and MeroShare remove the friction from opening an account.

stages.label: 2 · Boom
stages.note: Prices rise on real reasons. Early buyers make real money. Indistinguishable from a healthy bull market — because it is one.

stages.label: 3 · Euphoria
stages.note: New participants arrive who cannot name what the company does. Margin lending expands. Analysis becomes a screenshot in a Viber group.

stages.label: 4 · Distribution
stages.note: The index goes sideways at a high level while individual stocks quietly stop making new highs. It feels like consolidation.

stages.label: 5 · Panic
stages.note: NRB tightening. CD ratio past sustainable levels. FD rates above 11%. Margin unwound. −49.5%.
